description: This file contains functions for extracting, patching, and validating calibration data, as well as patching MAC addresses and removing regdomain information for wireless devices, specifically related to OpenWrt firmware.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs a dd command to copy data from source to target with specified block size, offset, and count.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a partition or device.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Extracts calibration data in reverse byte order and writes to firmware file.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a source file to firmware file.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data into sysfs from a file.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Checks if the firmware file has the expected magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_data
methods.description: Patches calibration data and checksum in firmware file.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address in firmware data.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address and checksum in firmware data.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath11k devices with specific MAC ID.

methods.name: ath10k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regdomain info for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regdomain info for ath11k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_set_macflag
methods.description: Sets MAC flag in firmware data for ath11k devices.
